changelog:
Initial release focusing on practical backyard livestock management starting with chickens and progressing to goats.

- Provides step-by-step guidance for raising chickens for eggs, then scaling up to goats for milk/meat/land management.
- Includes thorough readiness checklist: zoning, time, space, budget, and predator proofing.
- Contains agent adaptation guidelines for users outside the US (legal, breed, climate/regulatory localization).
- Lists trusted reference materials and when to use the skill.
- Emphasizes daily commitment, realistic startup/ongoing costs, and core health/housing requirements.
summary: Practical small livestock management starting with chickens and progressing to goats. Use when someone wants to raise chickens for eggs, keep goats for milk...
